fact: AGT says it is building its own in-house AI system trained on internally supplied data, with machine-learning tests since 2024.

Angola Telecom and the Digital Africa Development Agency announced an investment programme, backed in its first phase by the Agence Francaise de Developpement, for an AI factory to be hosted in Angola Telecom data centres, with a proof of concept of Mistral AI models launched at ANGOTIC 2025 in Luanda on 12-14 June 2025.

fact: Angola Cables announced at its 28 November 2025 Luanda-02 node launch that its Clouds2Africa cloud platform will 'soon' offer GPUs, which its innovation director Julio Chilela said suit AI and machine learning work.

Angola Cables launched GO4AI on 12 June 2026 at ANGOTIC 2026 in Luanda, a self-service marketplace offering on-demand GPUs (NVIDIA L40S, A100, B200) and NPUs for AI training and inference, billed in local currency, per Forbes Africa Lusofona.
